justification: Inspected `android-integration/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/integration/android/IntentIntegrator.java` and `IntentResult.java`, `android-integration/pom.xml`, `pom.xml`, and `docs/apidocs/com/google/zxing/integration/android/package-use.html`. The package contains only these two classes; a repo-wide search found no source references to `IntentIntegrator` or `IntentResult` outside the package itself, and the package-use doc lists only the same package as a user. Its Maven POM shows only an external Android dependency and no dependency on other ZXing modules, so there is no evidence of this package depending on a less stable internal package.
